--- before/artefacts/sprints/sprint-001/sprint-backlog/developer-plan.md
+++ after/artefacts/sprints/sprint-001/sprint-backlog/developer-plan.md
@@ -7,3 +7,5 @@
 # Developer Plan
 
 Implement the greeting with Python. Automated named-user test, independent Tester check, PO assessment, collective Done. Sprint active; setup work is allowed. No UI.
+
+Handoff preparation: pin Flake8 7.3.0 and its dependencies in `product-code/requirements-dev.txt`; cover all Python implementation and test files with `make -C product-code quality`. Install prerequisites with `python3 -m pip install -r product-code/requirements-dev.txt`. Review final lint and test evidence before handoff. Git metadata is absent in this fixture, so the original implementation diff, branch, and commit base cannot be verified. No commit or external PR is created.
--- before/product-code/requirements-dev.txt
+++ after/product-code/requirements-dev.txt
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+flake8==7.3.0
+mccabe==0.7.0
+pycodestyle==2.14.0
+pyflakes==3.4.0
--- before/product-code/.flake8
+++ after/product-code/.flake8
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+[flake8]
+max-line-length = 79
+max-complexity = 10
--- before/product-code/Makefile
+++ after/product-code/Makefile
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+PYTHON ?= python3
+
+.PHONY: quality lint test
+quality: lint test
+
+lint:
+	$(PYTHON) -m flake8 --config .flake8 .
+
+test:
+	$(PYTHON) -m unittest discover -s . -v
